title: Add a new how/mechanism while keeping content fixed
hypothesis: A new computation mechanism can be added by a small code on a frozen mechanism basis, preserving outputs for known content and using less complete state than an explicit new operator or retraining the shared substrate.

world.teacher: fixed content vectors pass through operators in a frozen rank-2 operator basis; new how is a combination of basis atoms

fresh.release_rule: Keep fresh sealed after native coefficient alias or full-byte gate failure.

controls: frozen shared operator basis with Mirror code

paid_objects: new operator code or explicit matrix

success_gate: new-how nRMSE <=0.02, retention nRMSE <=0.02, >=25% fewer full bytes than explicit operator, and strict gain over native coefficient code.
failure_gate: FAIL if native factor code aliases Mirror or complete bytes miss gate.
boundaries: Synthetic linear operations only; no reasoning/continual-learning claim.
The frozen operator basis is a synthetic addressability control, not a learned mechanism basis.
No fresh seeds after development failure or exact native alias.
